text: Evidence record, not authority. Re-measurement of packages/polaris-generation-consent/src/package-reader.test.ts after syzygy-bpyt.4.8 moved every recorder render to one asynchronous python3 run at the top of the file, and the re-sizing of the fifteen timeouts PR #520 sized for their renders (syzygy-bpyt.4.8 comment of 2026-10-24). Also the rule-6 mutants of the two testkit pins (review N1, N2 of docs/reviews/R-GP-IMPL-RECORDER-BATCHED-RENDER-RAW.md).

host.note: load1 stayed under 22 during every run; the host did not reach load1 >= 100 and no load was generated, since other lanes share it. The fifteen were last sized at load1 up to 127 (docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-4-13/timeout-sizing.json); this record does not measure that load.

sizing.command: python3 -I scripts/size_vitest_test_timeouts.py . --file packages/polaris-generation-consent/src/package-reader.test.ts --project integration --record before-alone.json --record before-full-1.json --record before-full-2.json --after after-alone.json --out timeout-sizing.json --check
problems: carries 50000 ms, the rule gives 15000 ms: the policy port and the strict policy chain agree on every world in the fixture set, at every instant
sizing.whyTheOneProblemStands: The agreement sweep carries 50000 ms and these records alone give it 15000 ms (worst 3794 ms at load1 <= 21.4). It keeps 50000 ms: its cost is syzygy-bpyt.4.23's (R-GP-IMPL-PACKAGE-READER-TIMEOUTS-1 N2), and a run at load1 127.56 cut it at 16465 ms (docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-4-13/load-127-report-extract.json), above 15000 ms.

fifteen.rule: Each measured at or under 2500 ms in all 5 before observations and all 5 after observations, every run passed, so each keeps the 5000 ms default (the rule of scripts/size_vitest_test_timeouts.py). Hosted runs were not consulted.

rows.name: screening scope version 2 policy act counts the version 2 act when the policy carries the version 2 bytes, and the version 1 act goes quiet
package admission reader returns a record only for an instance that an act record names by path and digest
egress version 2 record refuses when version 2 did not take effect strictly after version 1: the same instant, or earlier
strict act reads policy chain: absent without acts; refused for a missing version 1, equal or earlier instants, equal arguments, a supersession that does not name version 1, or other policy bytes
egress version 2 record is read from the recorder's act: version 2 supersedes version 1 once in force
egress version 2 record the RFC5-14 class amendment version 2 depends on is required: no record, an edited module, a wrong form, or an amendment later than version 2 all refuse
egress version 2 record withdrawal and forgery forms the reader does not define does not refuse the recorders' other act records or the aggregate acceptance record they append to
egress version 2 record leaves version 1 standing before the version 2 act takes effect, and with no version 1 act at all
screening scope version 2 policy act a version 2 act not yet in force leaves version 1 in force, in both views
public-source policy act refuses the recorder's file when its act type, identity, title or provenance is not the recorder's form
round-3 review notes takes a time: a strict read of an act recorded after now is absent (N-4)
public-source policy act recognises the recorder's record by its exact path and format, in force from its instant
screening scope version 2 policy act refuses an unlisted record that names the policy: another file, a subdirectory, a loose field spelling, a Unicode-hyphen identity
round-3 review notes folds soft hyphens, zero-width spaces, underscores and spaces before matching a withdrawal stem (N-2)
package admission reader refuses the whole read on unknown shapes instead of guessing

mutants.note: N1-invert-filter is killed at beforeAll (the installed-path probe renders over a root with no entry and now throws ENOENT), not by the edge case it targets.

rows.old: const installed = stat?.isFile() === true ? readFileSync(entry) : null;
rows.new:
let installed: Uint8Array | null = null;
  try { if (stat?.isFile() === true) installed = readFileSync(entry); } catch { /* bare */ }
